final_message:
Yen receipts now show correctly, and the yen receipt test passes along with the other 17 tests.

The bug was in `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divided every amount by 100, so 500 yen came out as `¥5.00`. Yen has no minor unit, so I added a zero-decimal currency set (just `JPY` for now) that skips the division and decimals.

`formatMoney` is shared, so cart totals and invoice lines also show yen correctly now. No other tests use yen, so nothing else changed. If you support other zero-decimal currencies such as KRW, add them to that set.
